title: brickellia wrightii var. tenera
intro: Brickellia wrightii var. tenera, commonly known as Wright's brickellia, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a shrubby perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. Wright's brickellia is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, likely due to its ability to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Wright's brickellia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
